# SePer Project Page

SePer is a utility-centric metric for RAG evaluation. It measures retrieval utility via semantic perplexity reduction.

## Canonical links
- Project page: https://sepermetric.github.io/
- Paper (arXiv): https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.01478
- Paper (OpenReview / ICLR 2025 Spotlight): https://openreview.net/forum?id=ixMBnOhFGd
- Code: https://github.com/sepermetric/seper
